task.ques: Find the latest research paper about neural networks published on ArXiv which has been submitted within the last week.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: “On the stability of learning” by John J. Vastola (arXiv:2610.35856), submitted 26 October 2026 at 17:58:14 UTC, is the latest result for neural networks within the last week (20–27 October 2026).

Evidence: arXiv’s advanced search for “neural network” OR “neural networks,” filtered by original submission date to 20–27 October 2026 and sorted by Submission date (newest first), lists this paper first among 246 results. Its abstract examines learning stability in biological neural networks and single-layer and multi-layer linear networks. The paper’s submission history confirms the timestamp.
